The question of adding a capital reserve line item to the November Town Meeting warrant will be taken up and voted on at the October 28th meeting, since it is not on tonight's agenda and time is short.

The commission will not vote on the related 763 Massachusetts Ave (old funeral home) waiver tonight because it was not properly on the agenda; it will be addressed at a future meeting.

The commission asked residents interested in filling its vacant commissioner seat to contact the DPW office or Town Hall about applying.

what_happened.line: The Sewer Commission granted a sewer easement waiver for 792 Massachusetts Avenue (Stone Farm) on a 3-0 vote.
A hearing on an easement waiver for 830/832 Massachusetts Avenue could not proceed for lack of a voting quorum, after one member recused and another was absent.
That hearing was formally continued to the October 28th meeting on a 3-0 vote.
A decision on whether to add a capital reserve line item to the November Town Meeting warrant was pushed to the October 28th meeting instead of being taken up tonight.
A related waiver request for 763 Massachusetts Avenue (the old funeral home) was not voted on because it was not properly listed on tonight's agenda.

why_it_matters: The 792 Massachusetts Avenue waiver clears a sewer easement step for that property, while owners at 830/832 and 763 Massachusetts Avenue still have unresolved hearings pending action on October 28th.
Whether a capital reserve line goes on the November Town Meeting warrant is a question residents may be asked to vote on directly.
The commission has a vacant seat and asked residents interested in serving to contact the DPW office or Town Hall.
